experiment: L37 joint geometry evaluation: raw diffusion vs marginal vs factorized train prior
fit_data: L32 training split only; held-out split used only for evaluation
limitations: The factorized prior samples empirical training marginals and is not a neural generator.
It is suited to this procedural independent-geometry curriculum and should not be assumed to generalize to correlated or natural geometry.
This result concerns structured geometry plus a CPU renderer; raw RGB diffusion remains gated separately.
deployment: Available in sample_geometry_collision.py as --geometry-sampler factorized_train_prior. Raw L34 diffusion remains the default learned route.
